structures.reason: T2 seams along the load every 40 A (pores 4.0 A at pitch 8.0 A, one row through the crack centre, tips 30 A from the next rows) + 20 A crack perpendicular to the load, registry 0
structures.hypothesis: rule: strength and W of the cracked pristine reference (18.8 N/m, 0.91 J/m2 after the 100 -> 120 A cell correction) reduced by the seam porosity 0.037; Cook-Gordon: rows of pores along the load are weak in tension across the row (row net section 0.50, ~8 N/m against ~29 N/m for the sheet); the stress parallel to the crack ahead of the tip (~1/5 of the opening stress) opens the row 30 A ahead of the tips before the crack arrives, deflecting and blunting it: W ratio >= 1.3 with the strength within 10 % of the cracked pristine reference
